# Ads n' Codes

> Marketing and technology agency based at B Hive, Level 3, BurJuman Business Tower, Dubai, serving businesses across all seven emirates of the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain).

Contact: bd@adsncodes.com (projects), hello@adsncodes.com (general), +971 56 544 0310 (call and WhatsApp).

## Services
- [Social media agency](https://adsncodes.com/social-media-agency-dubai.html): content calendars, reels, community management and paid social for UAE brands
- [Lead generation](https://adsncodes.com/lead-generation-agency-dubai.html): Meta and Google lead campaigns, landing pages, lead qualification and instant WhatsApp follow up, reported as cost per lead and booking
- [PPC and Google Ads](https://adsncodes.com/ppc-google-ads-agency-dubai.html): Google Search, Performance Max and YouTube ads in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, with call and WhatsApp conversion tracking
- [Instagram and Facebook marketing](https://adsncodes.com/instagram-marketing-agency-dubai.html): Instagram management, reels, DMs and Meta ads including Click to WhatsApp, tracked to enquiries
- [Digital marketing](https://adsncodes.com/digital-marketing-dubai.html): social media marketing, Meta and Google ads, performance marketing, lead generation
- [SEO](https://adsncodes.com/seo-agency-dubai.html): technical and local SEO, Google Business Profile, AEO and GEO
- [Branding](https://adsncodes.com/branding-agency-dubai.html): brand strategy, logo, identity, packaging, company profiles
- [Personal branding](https://adsncodes.com/personal-branding-dubai.html): personal brand strategy, LinkedIn and Instagram content, founder videos and portraits for founders, CEOs, doctors and experts
- [Content creation](https://adsncodes.com/content-creation-dubai.html): social content, ad creatives, motion graphics, copywriting
- [Influencer marketing](https://adsncodes.com/influencer-marketing-dubai.html): creator sourcing and vetting, UAE Media Council Advertiser Permit compliance, campaign management and paid amplification on Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat
- [UGC content](https://adsncodes.com/ugc-content-dubai.html): UGC video ads, unboxings, reviews and testimonials by UAE creators for TikTok, Reels and Meta ads
- [Photography](https://adsncodes.com/photography-dubai.html): product, real estate, interior, corporate and event photography
- [Video production](https://adsncodes.com/video-production-dubai.html): brand films, video ads, reels, real estate walkthroughs
- [Events](https://adsncodes.com/event-photography-videography-dubai.html): event photography and videography, same day reels, event branding, event promotion and registration
- [Websites and e-commerce](https://adsncodes.com/web-development-dubai.html): websites, online stores, Amazon and Noon management
- [Apps and software](https://adsncodes.com/app-development-dubai.html): mobile and web apps, business software, CRM
- [WhatsApp automation and AI agent for lead response](https://adsncodes.com/whatsapp-ai-agent-uae.html): replies in seconds to every WhatsApp enquiry, from Google, Instagram, the website, referrals, regular customers and ads,, qualifies leads and books viewings, appointments and orders, for real estate, clinics, restaurants, e-commerce and more across the UAE
- [AI and automation](https://adsncodes.com/ai-automation.html): AI agents, WhatsApp AI, lead qualification, process automation
- [WhatsApp AI agent for real estate](https://adsncodes.com/whatsapp-ai-agent-real-estate-dubai.html): instant replies to portal and ad leads, qualification, live listings, viewings and agent handover for Dubai brokerages
- [WhatsApp AI agent for clinics](https://adsncodes.com/whatsapp-ai-agent-clinics-dubai.html): services, prices, doctors and booking by real availability, synced with clinic software
- [WhatsApp ordering for restaurants](https://adsncodes.com/whatsapp-ordering-restaurants-dubai.html): menu cards, typed orders, delivery or pickup, orders sent to the POS and kitchen
- Live WhatsApp AI agent demos: [real estate brokerage](https://realestate.adsncodes.com), [clinic](https://medicare.adsncodes.com), [restaurant](https://grillhouse.adsncodes.com)
- [Workflow automation](https://adsncodes.com/workflow-automation-dubai.html): lead routing, CRM updates, quotes, invoices, payment reminders, reports and approvals using n8n, Make, Zapier and Power Automate
